integrity.independence_of_numerics: The proof is analytic and does not depend on finitely many numerical checks.
integrity.proof_basis: Meromorphic theta functional equation, triangular Laurent principal parts, and global Laurent uniqueness.

scientific_limitations: Odd positive integer powers only; even exponents at least four are not treated.
The polynomial numerator is nonnegative at integral Fourier indices; no real-line nonnegativity assertion is made.
Explicit Gaussian covariance realizations do not give independent new zero-process correlation laws.
The precise historical priority of equivalent elliptic-theta identities is not completely settled.
title: Odd powers of weighted annular Szegő kernels have polynomial Laurent multipliers
